text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was lectured for three hours by the
counselor.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was conducting an experiment. Nothing
special.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I made a little mistake and ended up
breaking all
the windows in the
classroom.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was empty, so no one was hurt or
anything. I
don't understand why they
had to get so mad.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I was only half listening, yet I'm exhausted.
